title: 第22章 有仙人打过来了？
novel_title: 伪装隐世仙族后，大佬疯狂跪舔我
content_zh:
这里本来就有它和阿璃两个异世来客了，男主叶不凡也是个穿越佬，现在这个孟绯音也是个穿越的。

    虽然因为天道规则限制，装逼系统看不到她身上的剧情线，但通过孟绯音身上浓郁的气运值来看，她不是女主都对不起她这个气运值。

    “别想这么多，统子。你要知道，风浪越大鱼越贵，场面越混乱，咱俩能从中得到的收益就更多。现在，该是我们出场的时候了……”

    微生璃月抿嘴一笑，露出一副反派笑容。

    谢长泽几人站在微生璃月身侧，看到她嘴角露出的笑意后，不由生出一股冰冷之感。

    他们怎么感觉，小师妹这笑容有点可怕？

    不过下方演武场上，剧情确实如小师妹所描述一般发展。

    在孟绯音父母痛斥她不孝，竟敢谋杀手足，二皇子出面诉说自己喜欢的人只有她妹妹孟绯漓之后，南落帝国皇帝胞弟，二皇子的九皇叔终于闪亮登场，并且一出场就站在了孟绯音这边。

    “小师妹，你跟我说说，你是怎么猜到会有人出现替她撑腰的？”

    林不语实在好奇，小师妹这说的未免太准确了点，跟会算命一样。

    其他几双眼睛也齐刷刷看向她，眼神中是同样的好奇。

    “你们别瞎猜了，都是我猜的，一般画本子里都这么写。”

    其他几人：话本子？小师妹这样的身份竟然还会看那些话本子，简直不可思议。

    忽略掉几人探究的目光，在疑似女频文男主九皇叔出场之后，微生璃月抓住这个机会，跟统子买了个炸裂的出场特效。

    演武场上因九王爷出现跪了一地之际，虚空之上，蓦然裂开一道缝隙，闪着奇异光芒的裂缝中，一艘巨大仙舟缓缓从中驶出。

    淡金色的保护罩下，仙舟舰身上萦绕着如梦似幻般的光彩。

    仙舟庞大的身影笼罩下来，让演武场上众人纷纷抬头，望向那如神迹般存在的庞然大物。

    从没见过如此场景的人们惊呼：

    “这……这是什么，是神迹降临，还是仙人打过来了？”

    “如此庞大的巨物，恐怕是仙人降临我们南落，此乃我南落大幸啊！”

    “不知这仙人是何模样，我等此生有幸，竟能亲眼得见仙人面容。”

    ……

    渡星槎还未落下，微生璃月就听到了一连串的装逼值入账声。
content_en:
There were already two visitors from another world, it and A Li. The male protagonist Ye Bufan was also a time traveler, and now Meng Feiyin was also a time traveler.

Although the pretentious system cannot see her plot line due to the restrictions of heavenly rules, judging from Meng Feiyin's strong luck, even if she is not the heroine, she has a lot of luck.

"Don't think so much, Tongzi. You have to know that the bigger the storm, the more expensive the fish, and the more chaotic the situation, the more benefits we can get from it. Now, it's time for us to appear..."

Weisheng Liyue pursed her lips and showed a villain smile.

Xie Changze and others stood beside Weisheng Liyue. After seeing the smile on her lips, they couldn't help but feel a cold feeling.

Why do they feel that Junior Sister's smile is a bit scary?

However, in the martial arts arena below, the plot did develop as described by the junior sister.

After Meng Feiyin's parents reprimanded her for being unfilial and daring to murder her siblings, and the second prince came forward and told her that the only person he liked was her sister, Meng Feili, the emperor's brother of the Nanluo Empire, the ninth uncle of the second prince, finally made his debut, and stood by Meng Feiyin's side as soon as he appeared.

"Junior sister, tell me, how did you guess that someone would show up to support her?"

Lin Buyu was really curious. What the junior sister said was too accurate, as if she could tell fortunes.

Several other pairs of eyes also looked at her, with the same curiosity in their eyes.

"Stop guessing. It's all my guess. It's usually written like this in drawing books."

Others: Storybook?It's simply unbelievable that a junior sister with such a status can still read those story books.

Ignoring the probing glances of several people, after the suspected male protagonist of the female video, Uncle Nine Emperors, appeared, Weisheng Liyue seized the opportunity and bought an explosive special effect for the appearance with Tongzi.

When the Ninth Prince appeared on the martial arts field and knelt on the ground, a gap suddenly opened in the void. From the gap that shone with strange light, a huge fairy boat slowly sailed out.

Under the protective cover of pale gold, the Fairy Boat was filled with a dreamlike brilliance.

The huge figure of the immortal boat was shrouded, causing everyone in the martial arts field to raise their heads and look at the giant creature that existed like a miracle.

People who had never seen such a scene exclaimed:

"This... what is this? Is it a miracle, or is it an attack from an immortal?"

"With such a huge giant, I'm afraid an immortal has come to our Nanluo. This is my great luck to Nanluo!"

"I wonder what this immortal looks like. I am so lucky in this life to be able to see the immortal's face with my own eyes."

…

Before Du Xingcha even landed, Weisheng Liyue heard a series of pretentious sounds.
title_en: Chapter 22 Is there an immortal coming?
